verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents several APIs (Alerts, Case, Case Import, Filing), so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, every OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404, and the ReadMe-hosted developer docs are entirely password-gated, with no public spec or reference available. No evidence shows a machine-readable spec a user can download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
